como: Join the class with your account. The site only stores that this account is in the course's class for that month.
Study the two lessons of the week when you can. What you have done is marked, read from your device.
Every Wednesday at 7:30 pm Brasília time, the class meets by video in the room, which only appears to those who joined.
The last meeting of the month is the seminar: someone presents a topic in 10 minutes.
Leave whenever you want: leaving deletes the record.

turma.sensivelTitulo: Before joining: this course is about politics
turma.sensivelTexto: To join the class, the Institute stores that this account is in the class of this course, which is about politics. Only your account sees it; you can leave whenever you want, and leaving deletes the record.
turma.sensivelLei: Taking part in a class about politics may reveal political opinion, which Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law 13,709/2018, art. 5, II) treats as sensitive personal data. That is why the record is only made with your specific and highlighted consent (art. 11, I), and you can withdraw it at any time by leaving the class (art. 8, § 5).

circulo.olho: Lúcia Maria Revolutionary School · for facilitators
circulo.lead: A tool for whoever facilitates a class meeting, in 5 steps inspired by Paulo Freire's culture circles. Everything stays only on this device: nothing goes to the server.
circulo.fonteTexto: GUIMARÃES, Alessandro et al. A palavra é... Paulo Freire. Pró-Discente, Vitória (ES), v. 23, n. 1, p. 61-78, Jan./Jun. 2017.
circulo.fonteNota: The article works through Freire's thought using generative words, in an exercise inspired by the culture circle. The 5 steps below are the Institute's adaptation for a video meeting.
circulo.p1Texto: Write down the words and problems the group brings, the way people say them. Do not write people's names.
circulo.p2Texto: With the group, choose a word or combine a few into a theme that sparks the conversation.
circulo.p3Texto: Guiding questions for the conversation. Use the ones that help and write others.
p3Guias: Where does this show up in our daily lives?
Why is it like this? Has it always been like this?
Who wins and who loses with this?
What have we, or other people, already done about it?
What can we do together from here?
circulo.p4Titulo: Look for lessons on the theme
circulo.p4Texto: The search runs on this device, in the site's lesson index. Choose the lessons and build a class-mode sequence, with a link and QR code for the group to open.
circulo.p4Falhou: Could not load the lesson index. Check the connection and try again.
circulo.p4Nada: No lesson on the site about this theme.
circulo.p4Qr: QR code of the sequence link
circulo.p5Titulo: If there is no lesson, request one
circulo.p5Texto: If the site has no lesson on the theme, ask through the contribute page: choose “An idea” and write the request. Nothing is sent automatically.
circulo.p5Pedir: Request a lesson on this theme
circulo.guardadosTexto: Up to {max} circles. The oldest are removed beyond that.
circulo.apagarTudo: Delete all circles on this device

banca.olho: Lúcia Maria Revolutionary School · final project
banca.lead: A 30-minute video conversation to present the course's final project. The in-person panel comes later.
roteiro: Presentation: the person explains the project, what they did and what they learned.
Conversation: questions from the panel and from the person, no exam and no trick questions.
Feedback: each skill on the sheet, with what went well and the next step.
banca.sala: The room is the course class room, for those who joined it, or another one agreed between the people.
banca.fichaTexto: No grade. Print it or fill it in on this device. What you write stays only here.

perguntas.clareza: Was it possible to understand the project and what was done?
perguntas.curso: Does the project use what the course taught?
perguntas.vida: Does the project speak to the lives of people in the community?

banca.pessoasTexto: Write only the names of people who agreed: each person must have given permission. It stays only in your record book.
banca.permissao: Each person whose name I wrote agreed to have it in my record book.
banca.registrado: Saved in your record book, on this device.
banca.falta: Choose the course, the date and write at least one piece of feedback.
banca.faltaPermissao: Confirm the permission of the people whose names are written, or delete the names.

cartaz.olho: Lúcia Maria Revolutionary School · the class's living archive
cartaz.lead: The collective poster of the graduating class. The facilitator types one sentence from each person. The course and the semester go on it; no full names. Everything is put together on this device.
cartaz.avisoNome: This sentence seems to contain a full name. Check it: the poster has no full names.
cartaz.imprimirDica: For a PDF, choose “Save as PDF” in the print dialog.
cartaz.falhou: Could not generate the image on this device.
cartaz.galeriaTitulo: To take the poster to the Gallery
cartaz.galeriaTexto: Nothing is published automatically. With the class's agreement, send the PNG through the Open Drawer, using the existing form: type “other” and the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence. The coordination checks it and adds the poster to the Gallery.

pausa.texto: For now we are not opening classes: we want enough people to look after each one with care. Courses and lessons remain open, at your own pace, and your progress stays on your device. When classes come back, this address will show them again.
